intro: Fire safety protects vulnerable people who often cannot escape unaided, so you must prevent fires, raise the alarm and evacuate safely.
points: If you discover a fire, raise the alarm first, then call 999 — never assume someone else has called.
Every fire needs heat, fuel and oxygen; remove any one side of the fire triangle and it cannot burn.
Emollient creams soak into fabric and burn fiercely, so keep users away from flames and wash bedding regularly.
Never wedge a fire door open — it only holds back fire and smoke when it is fully closed.
Care homes use progressive horizontal evacuation, moving residents sideways through fire doors into a protected compartment; never use lifts.
Everyone who cannot evacuate independently needs a PEEP; after evacuating, account for people and never go back inside.
